Based on obtaining the dead deviation, pure tracking model and incremental PID control algorithm, the automatic path tracking control of the tractor was achieved. After completing the hardware Information Processing in Agriculture 5 (2018) 422 – 432 423 development of the controller and the design of the software system, a ﬁeld experiment platform was built. Methods and materials 2.1. Crop row identiﬁcation and path planning Setting the centerline of the crop in the middle of the image as the target navigation path, a new crop row detection method based on Census transform was used in this paper [29]. The presented method consisted of three modules that are image preprocessing, feature points detection and crop row detection. Different steps and results of crop row detec- tion based on Census transform are given in Fig. 1 , the origi- nal color image was obtained by binocular camera ( Fig. 1 (a)). Firstly, an improved excess green minus excess red (ExG – ExR) function [30] was used to transform RGB color image to grayscale image ( Fig. 1 (b)). In order to describe the contour of crop rows, the smallest univalue segment assimilating nucleus (SUSAN) detector was used to detect corner points, which could describe the contour of crop rows. Then, the module of feature point detection consisted of stereo matching and 3D coordinate point calculation. The accurate stereo matching algorithm based on Census trans- form was used to calculate the disparity of SUSAN corner point ( Fig. 1 (c)). response:
## Análise da Pesquisa em Visão Computacional e Inteligência Artificial

Com base no contexto fornecido, segue a extração das informações solicitadas:

**1. Área Computacional:**

Redes Neurais Convolucionais / Deep Learning (Embora o texto mencione outros métodos como PID e Fuzzy control, o uso de Census Transform e a identificação de características visuais indicam um forte componente de processamento de imagem e, potencialmente, Redes Neurais Convolucionais para a detecção de pontos de interesse e reconhecimento de padrões.)

**2. Sensores Utilizados:**

- Câmera binocular
- Câmera monocular

**3. Bibliotecas, Frameworks ou Arquiteturas:**

- Census Transform (para correspondência estéreo e detecção de características)
- ExG – ExR (função para transformação de imagem RGB em escala de cinza)
- SUSAN detector (para detecção de pontos de canto)

**4. Solução / Tarefa Principal:**

- Navegação por trajeto (especificamente, controle de trajetória de um trator em linhas de plantio).
- Detecção de linhas de plantio (crop row detection)
- Path tracking control (controle de rastreamento de caminho).
